note: Candidate non-earthquake ground events, 17 Jun - 31 Oct 2026, found by web search of public pages (no catalogue download). Sources are search-result pages read on 14 Nov 2026; figures are quoted as the source gives them. 'nisar' = GUNW pairs found with the ASF search API (track/frame, 12-day pairs).

events.where: Langtang Lirung, Nepal-China border (28.3 N 85.5 E)
facts: Seismic signal 02:52 UTC on 26 Aug 2026 (Ms 5.2 USGS, Mw 5.7 GFZ), generated by the collapse itself (Wikipedia, citing USGS and GFZ)
estimated 132 million m3 of rock and glacier ice (ICIMOD preliminary synthesis, via search summary)
source zone about 2,000 m long with about 1,150 m drop (PreventionWeb)
Sentinel-1 showed up to 40 cm LOS deformation 7 Jul - 24 Aug (press coverage of a Virginia Tech analysis); a NISAR paper reports motion 20 Jun - 19 Aug 2026 (Remote Sensing 18(21):3727)
events.nisar: asc track 98 frame 16: 19-31 Aug (event), 14-26 Jul (control); desc track 48 frame 74: 16-28 Aug (event), 11-23 Jul (control)
events.verdict_reason: 8.5 km2 patch at 28.32 N 85.48 E, 4.7x the next largest, both look directions

events.where: Budhi Gandaki, Gorkha, Nepal (about 28.48 N 84.96 E, near Chumchet; location not surveyed)
facts: seismic data indicate the landslide at 04:22 local time, dam breach about 06:00 (Landslide Blog)
no volume or area published; flow smaller than the 26 Aug Langtang event (Landslide Blog)
ICIMOD preliminary assessment: flooding from the failure of a temporary landslide-induced river blockage
events.nisar: asc track 98 frame 16: 6-18 Oct; desc track 48 frame 74: 3-15 Oct
events.verdict_reason: control pair mean coherence 0.24-0.30 (monsoon-end vegetation); no patch at the published place, largest patches 0.7-1.4 km2 elsewhere; landslide size unpublished

events.where: Halemaumau, Kilauea summit, Hawaii (19.41 N 155.28 W)
facts: episode 55: 17 Oct 2026 03:19-09:06 HST, about 6 h, fountains up to 220 m, lava volume 7 million m3, overflows from north, south and west vents before fountaining (USGS HVO episode table, preliminary)
episodes 50-54 on 27 Jun, 15 Jul, 28-29 Jul, 12-13 Aug, 25 Aug 2026 (same table)
episode 51 lava covered about 50 % of the Halemaumau crater floor (Maui Now citing HVO)
events.nisar: asc track 151 frame 11: 10-22 Oct (event), 28 Sep-10 Oct (control); desc track 72 frame 79: 17-29 Oct (event), 5-17 Oct (control); single-episode pairs also exist for episodes 53 (asc 11-23 Aug) and 54 (asc 23 Aug-4 Sep, desc 18-30 Aug)
events.verdict_reason: 10.2 km2 patch in and south-west of Halemaumau, 8.4 km2 within 4 km vs background p95 0.44 km2 (ascending only; descending pair too noisy)

facts: eruption entering its seventh day on 13 Aug 2026 with lava fountains at Voragine and several vents feeding a lava field in the Valle del Bove (Euronews)
paroxysm on 30 Jul and an effusive phase from late June (go-etna.com / INGV bulletins via search summary); one flow volume about 500,000 m3 (vulkane.net on INGV bulletin 27 Jul-2 Aug)
events.nisar: asc track 43 frame 21: 23 Jul-16 Aug (24 d) vs 29 Jun-23 Jul; desc track 51 frame 69: 23 Jul-16 Aug vs 11-23 Jul
events.verdict_reason: 2.5 km2 strip east of the summit craters in the ascending pair; 1.2 + 1.0 km2 at the same place in the descending pair; 0.02 % of comparable ground elsewhere

events.where: near Brits, North West, South Africa (25.652 S 27.852 E, 'appears to have been', Landslide Blog)
facts: dam wall gave way on 13 Aug 2026; sludge released toward the neighbouring mine (Daily Maverick, SANSA Sentinel-2 note of 21 Aug confirms extensive sludge deposition)
no area or runout length published in the pages read
events.nisar: asc track 143 frame 165: 11-23 Aug vs 6-18 Jul; desc track 21 frame 101: 21 Jul-14 Aug vs 9-21 Jul
events.verdict_reason: 0.58 km2 patch within 1 km of the published failure point, same pixel in both look directions, but comparable to field-scale background patches (asc next largest 0.27 km2; desc 0.51 km2 elsewhere)

events.where: Lete, Mustang, Nepal (about 28.63 N 83.61 E, speculative per the author)
facts: large landslide on 27 Sep 2026 after heavy rain; valley appears blocked, breach within a short period; no size given
events.nisar: asc track 26 frame 16: 19 Sep-1 Oct; desc track 149 frame 74: 16-28 Sep
events.verdict_reason: 31-48 % of comparable ground loses coherence everywhere in the window (rain or snow in late September); nothing stands out at Lete
